gnu-bash.description: Base releases from the ftp.gnu.org/gnu/bash listing (bash-X.Y.tar.gz)

gnu-bash-patches.description: Official patches for one base version; packageName is the base, e.g. 5.3

packageRules.description: Only X.Y base tarballs; bash-X.Y.Z.tar.gz are old pre-patched snapshots
Patch files are bashXY-NNN; keep the zero-padded NNN (skip .sig files)
